issues.display_title: Issue #5: Remove invalid lat long data from typesense
issues.main_description_html:
QA Tester Summary - Issue #5: Remove invalid lat long data from typesense

Suite: qa-testing/specs/api/issue-5-invalid-lat-lng-typesense-static.spec.cjs (Node static/API contract check)
Env: Local source review on branch qa-testing
Evidence: qa-testing/evidence/logs/issue-5-invalid-lat-lng-typesense-static.json

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White typesense_lat_lng_contract Typesense data path has lat/lng model fields and validation strategy FN Failed
2 Gray valid_coordinate_flow_guardrails request coordinates are validated before coordinate lookup TP Pass
3 Black invalid_stored_coordinates_rejected invalid Typesense lat/lng is not returned or re-upserted FN Failed
4 Task Sprint #5 acceptance invalid lat/long data is removed or filtered from Typesense FN Failed

Backend Status Code & Review

Live HTTP testing was not executed because the local environment does not currently expose the go command in PATH, so the Go/Gin service could not be started from this workspace.

Probe Status Review
Static source check: coordinate endpoint request validation Pass GetPlaceByCoordinates validates incoming lat range -90..90 and lng range -180..180
Static source check: Typesense upsert validation Failed UpsertPlaceToTypesense writes place.Lat and place.Lng without range validation
Static source check: Typesense autocomplete filtering Failed AutocompletePlaces converts Typesense hits directly into predictions with stored Lat/Lng
Static source check: Typesense details filtering Failed searchTypesenseByField returns stored Typesense lat/lng directly
Static source check: cleanup/removal path Failed No cleanup/delete/remove flow for invalid lat/lng data was found

Code Review

  • Issue body is empty, so QA scope was inferred from the title.
  • handlers/places.go validates request coordinates for /places/coordinates, but this only protects user-supplied coordinate lookup input.
  • services/places.go does not validate lat/lng before saving to Typesense in UpsertPlaceToTypesense.
  • services/places.go does not filter invalid stored Typesense coordinates before returning autocomplete or detail results.
  • No explicit job, endpoint, script, or service function was found to remove invalid lat/long documents from Typesense.

Bug Notes

  • Bug 1: Invalid lat/lng can still be written to Typesense because upsert has no range validation.
  • Bug 2: Invalid lat/lng already stored in Typesense can still be returned by search/detail flows.
  • Bug 3: The requested removal/cleanup behavior is not implemented in the current source.

Verification Commands

node qa-testing/specs/api/issue-5-invalid-lat-lng-typesense-static.spec.cjs
go test ./...

Result

Failed. The app validates incoming coordinate lookup parameters, but it does not remove, reject, or filter invalid lat/long data in the Typesense storage/read paths.

issues.display_title: Issue #6: Debug Error API Search Address by Coordinate
issues.main_description_html:
QA Tester Summary - Issue #6: Debug Error API Search Address by Coordinate

Suite: qa-testing/specs/api/issue-6-search-address-coordinate-static.spec.cjs (Node static/API contract check)
Env: Local source review on branch qa-testing
Evidence: qa-testing/evidence/logs/issue-6-search-address-coordinate-static.json

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White coordinate_route_contract /places/coordinates route exists and is protected by auth TP Pass
2 Gray coordinate_lookup_flow valid coordinates use Typesense first then Google fallback TP Pass
3 Black invalid_coordinate_input missing, non-numeric, and out-of-range lat/lng are rejected TN Pass
4 Task Sprint #6 debug acceptance coordinate API handles provider failures safely FN Failed

Backend Status Code & Review

Live HTTP testing was not executed because the local environment does not currently expose the go command in PATH, so the Go/Gin service could not be started from this workspace.

Probe Status Review
Static source check: route registration Pass GET /places/coordinates is registered in main.go with AuthMiddleware()
Static source check: required query params Pass lat and lng are required
Static source check: invalid query params Pass non-numeric lat/lng and out-of-range coordinates are rejected
Static source check: Typesense lookup Pass service checks Typesense within a small coordinate window
Static source check: Google fallback Pass service falls back to Google Geocoding when Typesense has no match/error
Static source check: Google HTTP status handling Failed getPlaceByCoordinatesFromGoogle does not check resp.StatusCode before reading/parsing body

Code Review

  • Issue body contains only an image attachment, so QA scope was inferred from the title and coordinate API implementation.
  • handlers/places.go has solid request validation for /places/coordinates: missing params, parse errors, and coordinate ranges.
  • services/places.go tries Typesense first, then falls back to Google Geocoding.
  • Unlike other Google API callers in this file, getPlaceByCoordinatesFromGoogle does not check resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK before reading/parsing the response body.
  • If Google returns a non-200 error page or non-standard error body, the API can report a misleading parse/status error instead of a clean upstream HTTP failure.

Bug Notes

  • Bug 1: getPlaceByCoordinatesFromGoogle lacks an HTTP status check before parsing the Google Geocoding response.
  • Risk: provider-side errors can be harder to debug and may surface as generic parse/no-results errors.
  • Not reproduced live because Go runtime is unavailable in PATH for this workspace.

Verification Commands

node qa-testing/specs/api/issue-6-search-address-coordinate-static.spec.cjs
go test ./...

Result

Failed. The route and input validation exist, but the Google fallback path does not validate upstream HTTP status before parsing the geocoding response.

Env: Local source review on branch qa-testing
Evidence: qa-testing/evidence/logs/issue-9-google-search-save-typesense-static.json

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White search_route_contract /search route exists and is protected by auth TP Pass
2 Gray typesense_first_google_fallback search checks Typesense first, then Google autocomplete when local result is not usable TP Pass
3 Gray google_autocomplete_save Google autocomplete predictions are enriched with details and auto-saved to Typesense TP Pass
4 Gray google_detail_save Google place detail fallback is auto-saved to Typesense after lookup TP Pass
5 Gray google_coordinate_save Google coordinate/geocoding fallback is auto-saved to Typesense after lookup TP Pass
6 White typesense_upsert_contract Typesense upsert payload includes required place fields and validates response TP Pass

Backend Status Code & Review

Live HTTP testing was not executed because the local environment does not currently expose the go command in PATH, so the Go/Gin service could not be started from this workspace.

Probe Status Review
Static source check: route registration Pass GET /search is registered in main.go with AuthMiddleware()
Static source check: search handler Pass SearchPlaces calls services.AutocompletePlaces(query) and returns results.Resource
Static source check: Typesense-first search Pass AutocompletePlaces searches Typesense before Google autocomplete
Static source check: Google autocomplete enrichment Pass Google predictions call getGooglePlaceDetails(...) to populate lat/lng
Static source check: Google autocomplete save Pass Google autocomplete detail result is passed to UpsertPlaceToTypesense in a background goroutine
Static source check: Google detail fallback save Pass GetPlaceDetails auto-saves Google fallback details to Typesense
Static source check: Google coordinate fallback save Pass getPlaceByCoordinatesFromGoogle auto-saves Google geocoding results to Typesense
Static source check: Typesense upsert validation Pass Upsert validates non-OK HTTP status and success response

Code Review

  • Issue body is empty, so QA scope was inferred from the title.
  • services.AutocompletePlaces already implements the expected search flow: Typesense first, Google autocomplete fallback when local results are not sufficient.
  • When Google autocomplete returns predictions, the code fetches details per prediction, copies lat/lng into the response, then saves the detail object to Typesense asynchronously.
  • Detail and coordinate fallback flows also auto-save Google results to Typesense, so future lookups can use local data.
  • No blocking bug found in the current source for the requested save-to-Typesense behavior.

Bug Notes

  • No bug found for issue #9 based on static/API contract review.
  • Residual risk: the async save path was not verified against a running Go service or live Typesense instance because go is unavailable in PATH in this workspace.

node qa-testing/specs/api/issue-9-google-search-save-typesense-static.spec.cjs
go test ./...

Result

Passed. The current backend source already auto-saves Google search/detail/coordinate fallback data into Typesense through UpsertPlaceToTypesense.
